column3: of the lords of the daityas
of the one to be meditated on
I worship with necks pierced by sharp trident
of women hearing, minds attentive to their sons
with sharp spears, laughing, not reaching
with sharp arrows, to him proud of being unconquered
drinking solely the stories sung by the mouths of Shesha and all
for the sake of the supreme good
from conception to the cremation ground
only of the mother who conceives
experience of the happiness of liberation by negation
served by swarms of bees drunk with honey
with gold necklaces and fine clothes
by atonements declared by the Vedic speakers
by atonements declared by the Vedic speakers likewise
one who has done the Lord's command
pressing the vitals of all creatures
having crossed the ocean of the enemy's force
then struck with the sword's edge
of the led and lifted up
having led, then the chaste woman should serve
having led, should give up the body
when he was led away by demons in the pot of nectar
by the birth of the lotus
lake of blue and red lotuses, white lotus, night lotus, blue lotus
with rows of blue curling locks
accompanied by Nila, Angada, Panasa and others, went
earrings faces adorned by bees of blue locks
nose adorned with rows of blue curls
dark as a blue lotus petal
by play with waist-knot and breasts, nail tips
we shall describe Tamisra and Andhatamisra
... with the glance of red compassion of eyes whirled by pride in love's passion
on the chest of the one of mighty strides
with tawny, curled matted locks wet with each morning bath
fresh saffron of the breasts, beautiful
human birth, the best of all births
the error of unity of men
by incarnations as man, animal, sage, god, fish
worlds by incarnations as man, animal, sage, god, fish
with dance, song and so on
with dance, songs and many fit things
with dance, songs and so on
dances with arms raised, arisen weapon
dances with arms raised, loud laughter, thunder-split directions
the kings' minds robbed by his generous laughter and bashful glances
the king with eyes blooming with joy
the Lord in the form of a king
with the guise of kingly marks
bearing the mark of a king
crest-jewels of kings, Anga, Vainya, Jayanta, Nahusha, Gaya and others
the king's head, foot, great, for the sacrifice
dwelling in the king's inner apartments
for the desire of battle of kings
by kings' rubbing, bathing, anointing, ornaments, protection, tilak, food
by men with swords and shields in hand
men went out to see this
guardians of the human world, guardians of the lower world
the human world, unconquered in senses
Achyuta in palanquins of men, horses and gold
to Narahari, protector of all dharma
destroying the darkness of ignorance of men
not wishing the Self in the Self
(they) do not wish the Self within
the ignorant who does not wish imitates
you deserve to take the sinless
in the range of the eyes
should join the syllable "na" to the eyes
tear drops fell from the eyes
from the eyes' water of the daughter
sounded at the final bath festival
sounded song, instruments, blessings of brahmanas
kettledrums and trumpets sounded many times
mridanga, drums, conches, kettledrums, Anakas sounded
the desired, by the qualities of the beholder
we shall lead, not yet gone through
though having senses should not strive
one following the Vedas should wander
did not wish you who went off the path
did not wish the throne of the emperor
the king did not wish the due
did not wish liberation, of the lord of liberation
should not teach this to the wicked or the unhumble
the ancient sages did not do this
not of the abode of all power
the person not taking refuge in Achyuta
not by gain of the Self
they would not do for us
of our elder brother, knower of the Self
Indra did not stir from his seat
because the ocean does not overflow
and no agitation of the qualityless
should not use what is offered
not the great who were worshipped
like a boat from the ocean
on the road, with mind tinged by ignorance, desire and action, purposeless
not departed from Death, not risen to a position
in the form of teacher and temple
remaining in the removed equality and excellence
hard as thunderbolt, from the blow of the palm
... from the roar the elephants of the directions terrified, claw-tips of lions
even by the wish of the unborn
placed in the water for pouring
fell in the ocean of dissolution
obstructing, with tears falling, from eagerness
killed by hunting and so on
lived, doing what was dear to him
sat down, absorbed in samadhi yoga
sat down on the earth, having touched
by sages who have laid down the rod, whose glory is told
to him whose waves of power are laid down
searched for what was laid down
laid down in you he sits
having placed in the Self, then
having laid aside, mounted the horse
struck with arrows as if with teeth
killed for release from the curse
killed with sharp arrows in the forest
would have killed at the end
whose abode, moving and unmoving, is set within
